scripts.cap:sync: npm run build && npx cap sync android
scripts.build:apk: npm run cap:sync && cd android && export JAVA_HOME=/opt/homebrew/opt/openjdk@21 && ./gradlew assembleDebug && cp app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk ../build-artifacts/BlockBlastStar.apk
scripts.build:aab: npm run cap:sync && cd android && export JAVA_HOME=/opt/homebrew/opt/openjdk@21 && ./gradlew bundleDebug && cp app/build/outputs/bundle/debug/app-debug.aab ../build-artifacts/BlockBlastStar.aab
